dataset.name: WTC 1 V8V OpenRadioss deformable engine-and-cowling qualification submodel
dataset.scope: Preserve V8U by hash and metric as a rigid-projectile regression reference, then qualify a minimal deformable equivalent engine core and cowling against a three-column by three-story shell facade assembly. V8V tests TYPE7 deformable contact, projectile erosion, mesh convergence, time-step convergence, momentum balance, energy balance, and one-versus-four-thread repeatability. It is not a JT9D reconstruction, a full aircraft model, a global WTC impact replay, a fire calculation, a collapse calculation, or a test of an explosive or thermite mechanism.

evidence_policy.observed_fact: Directly read from a cited source file or solver output.
evidence_policy.official_model_result: A value reported by a NIST or Altair numerical model; it is not an observation of the real event.
evidence_policy.local_archive_claim: A statement from the read-only archive; none is used as a new physical input in V8V.
evidence_policy.model_hypothesis: A declared simplification or parameter without an exact source for the modeled location or component.
evidence_policy.derived_result: A deterministic calculation from declared inputs and solver outputs.
evidence_policy.unknown: A missing value or physical capability not qualified by V8V.

uses: three-column by three-story prefabricated panel description
engine impact centered on panel 124 near floor 96
20,100 lb for two engines with cowlings; V8V uses one half as the total equivalent projectile mass
interface FNZ history; its end-minus-start change is used as the solver-reported contact impulse and is independently checked against projectile momentum change
part momentum, energy, mass and eroded-element histories
time-step scale-factor sensitivity without mass scaling

facade_geometry.model_type: three closed square shell columns joined by three spandrel strips over a three-story prefabricated-panel height
facade_geometry.boundary_condition: all translational and rotational degrees of freedom fixed at the top and bottom column-edge nodes only
facade_geometry.joint_representation: shared shell nodes at column-spandrel boundaries; no explicit weld, bolt, splice plate, floor slab or truss-seat model
facade_geometry.epistemic_status: model_hypothesis constrained by official nominal geometry
limitations: The three-story extent matches the documented prefabricated panel scale but not a provenance-complete panel-124 assembly.
The exact as-built panel-124 plate schedule at floor 96 remains unavailable in the frozen local source set.
The 5/16 in column and 3/8 in spandrel values are representative nearby values, not an exact panel-124 schedule.
The closed-square column construction is a contact-qualification surrogate, not a fabricated-section reconstruction.

facade_material.failure_status: mesh-dependent hypothesis; not a measured panel-124 fracture law

projectile.mass_origin: one half of the V8S 20,100 lb two-engines-with-cowlings ledger
projectile.impact_location: centered on the middle column and middle spandrel of the three-story facade surrogate

engine_core.shape: closed square shell box equivalent core

cowling.shape: open-rear square shell cowling with a front annular frame

projectile.mass_calibration: For each projectile mesh, the uniform equivalent shell thickness of each part is calculated from its target ledger mass divided by density and generated shell mid-surface area. The resulting thickness is an explicit equivalent-mass hypothesis, not an as-built JT9D wall thickness.
projectile.epistemic_status: model_hypothesis constrained only by total engine-with-cowling mass and impact speed
limitations: No JT9D rotating machinery, casing layers, shafts, fan blades, mounts or sourced joint topology.
Square equivalent core and cowling replace the real engine geometry.
No wing, fuel, fuselage, pitch, yaw or oblique trajectory.
Projectile strength and rupture parameters are qualification hypotheses, not component test data.

contact.facade_interface: /INTER/TYPE7 projectile nodes to facade shell surface
contact.projectile_self_contact: /INTER/TYPE7 projectile nodes to projectile shell surface
contact.edge_to_edge_contact: not included; TYPE7 is node-to-segment and V8V does not qualify TYPE11 edge-to-edge contact
contact.epistemic_status: official solver formulation with declared frictionless qualification settings

predeclared_gates.scope_warning: Passing V8V qualifies only this two-part deformable shell projectile, TYPE7 settings and three-column by three-story facade surrogate. It does not validate a JT9D breakup model, NIST's global damage state, an aircraft-wide debris field, a fire-to-collapse chain, Blender dynamics, or any demolition hypothesis.
